title: SSS-Class Suicide Hunter
altTitles: 死して生きるSSS級ハンター
นักล่าพลีชีพ ระดับ SSS
description: Kim Gong-ja is an F-rank hunter who envies the legendary Flame Emperor and desperately wishes for an S-rank skill. His wish is granted, but his new skill only activates when he dies. After being killed by the Flame Emperor, Gong-ja discovers that he can copy another person's skill and travel back in time 24 hours whenever he dies. With this seemingly absurd ability, he begins climbing the mysterious Tower, repeatedly sacrificing himself to become stronger and changing the fate of everyone around him.
author: Shin Noah
